entities.name: Ferdinand Carré
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ferdinand Philippe Edouard Carré was a French engineer, born at Moislains (Somme) on 11 March 1824. Carré is best known as the inventor of refrigeration equipment used to produce ice. He died on 11 January 1900 at Pommeuse (Seine-et-Marne).
